title: Звезда
author: Михаил Лермонтов
translation: Shine on, shine on, distant star, / That I may meet you always in the night; / Your faint beam, battling with the darkness,

title: Звезда
author: Михаил Лермонтов
translation: Brings dreams to my ailing soul; / She flies to you on high; / And this breast feels free and light...

title: Звезда
author: Михаил Лермонтов
translation: I saw a glance, full of fire / (It has long since closed for me), / But as to you, to it I still fly;

title: Звезда
author: Михаил Лермонтов
text: И хоть нельзя  смотреть его хочу...
translation: And though I cannot look, I wish to look at it...
